variable.name: FocusColor
variable.description: THE focus color, used everywhere the skin shows focus: the user's pick (skin string FocusColor, set from Skin settings), else HL from colors/defaults.xml (Sand). HL is only used here and must not be used anywhere else.

variable.name: FocusBoxColor
variable.description: Color of the focus box behind text rows and buttons in menus and settings: invisible when 'Hide focus box in lists and menus' is on. Buttons cannot take a variable as a texture, so the box is hidden by making it transparent.

variable.name: FocusListLabel
variable.description: Focused list label. Only while the focus color is in use; with plain text in the focus box the label is left as it is. A plain copy of the name in the PlainLabel property wins (the skin's own picker dialogs set it). Else, if the label has [COLOR] formatting but the item has a clean title, show the title so the focus color shows. Items with no clean title are handled by the FocusColorOverride label instead (a skin cannot strip the formatting).
